evidence_quotes: Valmet is to deliver digitally enabled energy performance solutions for district heating and energy balance optimization to Gren’s Tartu Combined Heat and Power (CHP) plant and Anne Boiler Plant in Tartu, Estonia.
The order is included in Valmet’s orders received of the second quarter 2026.
